title: Deputy Robs Bank After Losing Cop Job
description:
A former Marion County deputy found herself on the wrong side of the law after robbing a bank in Ocala, Florida. Witnesses reported the suspect, Christina Thagard, dressed in a mask and hoodie, demanded $50,000 using a threatening note, but a tracking device stashed with the stolen cash led police right to her in minutes. Investigators later confronted her with evidence that led to some…big emotions. Watch the shocking incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Watch More Police Bodycam Videos: https://bit.ly/WatchBodycamVideos
Subscribe to Law&Crime BodyCam: https://bit.ly/LawAndCrimeBodyCam  

#Florida #Bodycam #LawAndCrime

Law&Crime is the leading multi-platform network that covers live court video, high-profile criminal trials, crazy crime, and smart legal analysis. Law&Crime BodyCam takes you on patrol and in the line of duty with raw footage of police encounters. Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
